app_info.subtitle: Find Norwegian experiences
app_info.description: Opplevagent is a curated marketplace of Norwegian experiences. Search hundreds of activities across all of Norway by county, municipality, category, season, weather and group size — northern lights cruises, whale and moose safaris, dog sledding, hiking and winter sports, museums and cultural sites, spa and wellness, farm stays, and food and drink experiences. Each listing carries the practical detail you need before you go: where it is, what it costs from, how long it takes, which season it runs in, and a link to the provider's own page. Opplevagent also covers gårdssalg — Norwegian farm-sale drink producers such as breweries, cideries, meaderies and vineyards — so you can find farms that welcome visitors, and send a visit request to the ones that take bookings. A request is never a confirmed booking and no payment happens in the conversation: the producer reviews it and answers by e-mail, and you pay on arrival. Useful when planning a trip to Norway, filling a weekend in the region you already live in, or finding something to do that suits the season and the weather.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read-only: it searches the experience catalogue by county, municipality, category, season, weather, group size, price and distance and returns the matches; it changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Closed world: it queries only Opplevagent's own catalogue database and calls no outside service; returning a provider's website link does not contact the provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: it only reads, so it cannot delete, overwrite or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes: it creates a pending visit request for one producer and e-mails the producer and the guest; it never confirms a booking and takes no payment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Open world: the producer and the guest receive e-mails, so the call reaches people outside the app.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: the e-mails to the producer and the guest are sent at once and cannot be recalled; ChatGPT asks for confirmation first, only producers that opted in to bookings accept requests, past or too-distant times are refused, and the producer decides whether to confirm, propose another time or decline.

test_cases.description: Norwegian seasonal search in one county — the core discovery flow. Renders the experiences-list card (web and mobile).
test_cases.user_prompt: Hva kan vi finne på i Troms om vinteren?
test_cases.expected_output: Experiences in Troms that run in winter or all year, for example Arctic Explorer — Northern Lights Cruise from Tromsø, Aurora Safari Camp — Fjord Tours Tromsø and dog sledding in Tromsø, Senja or Lyngen, each with municipality, category and a from-price where one is known. An experiences-list card shows the first five with a Details button and an opplevagent.no link each, plus a Show all button. No summer-only activity (such as sea kayaking on Senja) is listed.

test_cases.description: Details for one named experience. Renders the experience-detail card.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the details of the Arctic Explorer northern lights cruise in Tromsø
test_cases.expected_output: The record for Arctic Explorer — Northern Lights Cruise from Tromsø: category sightseeing, Tromsø (Troms), from NOK 800, about 3 hours, runs autumn to spring. The experience-detail card shows these facts, a note that booking and payment happen with the provider, a Go to provider button (arcticexplorer.no) and an opplevagent.no link.

test_cases.description: Category overview, so the user can see what kinds of experiences exist before narrowing down.
test_cases.user_prompt: Hvilke kategorier av opplevelser finnes på Opplevagent?
test_cases.expected_output: Ten categories, each with the number of verified listings: culture & history, nature & outdoors, adrenaline & action, sightseeing & transport, stays, wildlife & safari, winter & snow, food & drink, wellness & spa, and farm-sale drink producers (gårdssalg). The counts are live figures, so the exact numbers vary.

test_cases.description: English category search across the whole country; checks that an English prompt maps to the wildlife category.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find wildlife and animal experiences in Norway
test_cases.expected_output: Experiences in the wildlife & safari category spread over several counties, for example Andenes Whale Safari (Nordland), orca safaris with Northern Explorers in Nærøysund (Trøndelag), Atlanterhavsparken aquarium in Ålesund and dog sledding in Sirdal (Agder), shown in the experiences-list card. Every listed experience belongs to the wildlife & safari category.

test_cases.description: The gårdssalg side of the catalogue: farm-sale drink producers, with their booking status shown honestly. Text answer, no card.
test_cases.user_prompt: Finn gårdssalg og lokale drikkeprodusenter i Vestland
test_cases.expected_output: Farm-sale drink producers in Vestland, for example 7 Fjell Bryggeri (brewery, Bergen), Balder Brygg (brewery, Sogndal), Kaupanger Vingard (vineyard, Sogndal) and Draopar (cidery, Eidfjord), each with municipality, producer type and a link to its opplevagent.no profile. Producers not yet taking bookings are shown as such, with a note to get in touch through the profile page.

negative_test_cases.description: No payment ever happens in the conversation. A gårdssalg request is a request, and the guest pays on arrival.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book the northern lights cruise for two people and charge my credit card now
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app does not take card details or charge anything. It points to the provider's own booking page for the cruise and explains that Opplevagent never handles payment.

negative_test_cases.description: The app cannot confirm a booking. Only the producer can, through their own reply.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Just confirm my farm visit for Saturday, don't wait for the producer
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app explains that a visit request always stays pending until the producer answers, that it has no way to confirm one itself, and offers to send a request instead.

negative_test_cases.description: Out-of-scope geography. The catalogue covers Norway only and must not present Norwegian results as an answer about another country.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find me a safari lodge in Kenya for next month
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app explains that it only covers experiences and farm-sale producers in Norway and does not offer Norwegian results as an answer about Kenya.

release_notes: Resubmission after the 2026-09-24 review (test cases did not produce correct results). Root causes found and fixed on the server: (1) the experiences-list and experience-detail cards read their data through an API the ChatGPT host does not provide, so in ChatGPT the list card said no experiences were found and the detail card was empty. Both cards now receive the tool result over the MCP Apps bridge (ui/notifications/tool-result, with window.openai.toolOutput as fallback), are served as text/html;profile=mcp-app with a declared domain and CSP, open links through the host, and support dark mode and phone widths; (2) the season filter matched only one spelling, so 'winter' dropped listings stored as 'vinter'; it now matches both languages and includes year-round listings; (3) the category parameter documented a slug that does not exist ('vinter'); it now lists the real slugs. Test cases now describe the expected result plus stable examples instead of exact counts. Annotations were re-checked: the three catalogue searches are closed-world (own database only) and book_gardssalg is destructive (it e-mails the producer and the guest). Please do not run book_gardssalg to completion against a listed producer: it notifies a real Norwegian farm.
